about: The editor image's OWN pins: the code-server base, its extensions, TypeScript, the one Debian package the runner's Python needs on this base, and the study page's code face. Kept apart from pins.json so an editor-only bump moves no runner tag. ⛔ No runtime version is chosen here: the editor copies every runtime out of the runner image, which pins.json alone governs. Every value is passed to docker/editor/Dockerfile by docker/editor/build.py. Each extension, TypeScript and the readline package name the one runtime they serve (`for`): a build installs them only when that runtime is in its declared set.

sources.what: multi-arch index digest (linux/amd64, linux/arm64); the tags latest and 4.137.0-trixie resolved to the same digest

base.why_not_single: an image digest is a content address: it verifies itself

sources.what: the tarball downloaded; its sha512 equals the registry's published integrity
the microsoft/TypeScript v6.0.3 release asset typescript-6.0.3.tgz carries the same sha256

typescript.why_not_single: two hosts publish the same bytes
typescript.note: 6.x is the newest major that is one JavaScript tarball with no dependencies; 7.x (npm latest) needs a per-platform native package

readline.why: the runner's Python links libreadline.so.8 from lib-dynload, and the code-server base does not carry it

sources.what: the trixie Packages index at the snapshot, the same timestamp pins.json uses for sqlite; apt verifies it against the signed Release with the base image's Debian keyring

readline.why_single: the archive signature is Debian's own; there is no second publisher of the package

face.why: the study page sets code in this face, regular and bold, vendored from the same release archive; the editor draws the practice's code in it so a reader sees one face on the page and in the frame. Each file's sha256 is the one the page's vendored copy carries, so the two are the same bytes

sources.what: the JetBrains/JetBrainsMono v2.304 release asset downloaded; its sha256 is the one the study page's pin records, and each file taken out of it hashes to the page's vendored file

face.why_single: the release archive is published on GitHub only; the value agrees with the page's own pin, taken independently
